name: South Carolina
overview: South Carolina's principal statewide residential relief uses value exemptions and school-operating-tax exemptions, rather than refundable property or renter credits.

programs.name: Homestead Exemption
programs.ageRule: 65 or older, totally and permanently disabled, or legally blind before the tax year.
programs.maximumBenefit: Tax exemption on the first $50,000 of fair market value in 2025.
programs.formulaSummary: Excludes qualifying home value from county, municipal, school and special-assessment property taxes; fees remain.
eligibilityNotes: At least one year of South Carolina legal residence before the tax year.
Qualifying spouse can meet age/disability condition.
interactions: The school-operating exemption applies only to value not already exempt under the homestead exemption; the homestead school-tax share is not counted a second time.

sources.title: 2025 South Carolina Tax Incentives for Economic Development, residential property-tax exemptions

programs.name: Legal-residence school operating tax exemption
programs.maximumBenefit: School operating property taxes on qualifying legal-residence value.
programs.formulaSummary: Qualifying owner-occupied legal residences are exempt from school operating millage, with debt millage and county/municipal taxes outside the exemption.
programs.application: Apply for legal-residence 4% assessment classification with county assessor; no separate school-exemption application.
eligibilityNotes: Primary residence; second homes do not qualify.
interactions: The school-operating exemption applies only to value not already exempt under the homestead exemption; the homestead school-tax share is not counted a second time.

sources.title: 2025 South Carolina Tax Incentives for Economic Development, residential property-tax exemptions

laterChanges: A temporary additional homestead exemption applies to some recipients in 2026; it does not apply to the 2025 reference year.
researchNotes: The listed statewide provisions exempt home value or school-operating taxes. The linked sources do not establish a statewide refundable property-tax or renter credit.
